title: Peaceful Vibrant Canvas Painting Colour Composition Specification
purpose: Contemporary expressive oil/acrylic paintings with attention-catching but gentle, optimistic colour balance, especially for modern Kerala interiors.
psychology_note: Colour-emotion associations are subjective and context-dependent; no palette guarantees peace, happiness, relaxation or neurological effects.

reference_artwork.subject: Vishnu reclining on Shesha
reference_artwork.visual_analysis: Peach and coral atmosphere with ocean teal currents, dusty blue figure, gold details, ivory breathing space; organic curves and controlled focal contrast.
reference_artwork.note: Visual estimates, not pixel-sampled or physical pigment measurements.

recommended_global_area_ratio.rule: These are functional colour groups and may overlap individual palette colour roles. For each palette use its explicit five-colour distribution as the source of truth.

composition_rules.dominance: Avoid equal-sized high-saturation patches. Establish one broad atmospheric field and a subordinate cool structure.
composition_rules.visual_flow: Use broad organic S-curves, diagonals and repeated rhythmic brushstrokes; provide low-detail resting zones.
composition_rules.value: Use light, middle and selective deep values; do not rely only on hue differences.
composition_rules.saturation: Concentrate maximum saturation in about 10–20% of the most important focal region, with softer surrounding colour.
composition_rules.edge_hierarchy: Sharpest edges near subject landmarks; soft or lost edges in background.
composition_rules.texture: Heavier impasto in flowing fabric and currents; restrained texture on faces, hands and quiet atmosphere.
composition_rules.fidelity: When composing a room mockup using an existing painting, preserve its actual geometry, composition, brushstrokes and colours; do not regenerate the art inside the frame.
composition_rules.testing: Review at thumbnail, room-view and close-up scale; check colour balance under daylight and warm indoor lighting.

palettes.name: Celestial Coral
palettes.best_for: Mythological figures, flowing cloth and lotus compositions
palettes.dominance_guidance: First two colours establish the main field; reserve saturated focal strokes for face, hands, flowers or movement lines. Percentages describe visible canvas area, not pigment mixing ratios.
palettes.calm_happy_balance: Keep large passages softly blended or broken-colour; use crisp high-chroma contrast only around the main focal area.

quality_checks: Each palette totals 100% visible canvas area.
Dominant colours visibly occupy their stated proportions.
High saturation is focal rather than uniformly spread.
There is enough light-value breathing room.
Warm/cool colours interweave without becoming muddy.
Facial features and symbolic objects remain readable where required.
Actual paint texture varies by passage.
Artwork is evaluated in its intended interior light.
